# Confidentiality undertaking: blank circulation form

This circulation form records proposed obligations without identifying the contracting parties. The expressions “the 'Discloser'” and “the 'Recipient'” describe capacities that will be completed in the signed instrument. They are not the names of individuals or private bodies.

1. Information supplied for evaluation must be used only to assess the proposed transaction. Access to a drawing does not confer a licence to manufacture the illustrated item or to distribute the drawing to another prospective supplier.
2. A recipient may retain a copy required by an applicable record-retention obligation. Any retained copy remains subject to the confidentiality restrictions. The existence of a retention obligation does not authorise continued commercial use.
3. A request for return must distinguish physical originals from working copies. A party asked to confirm destruction must state any permitted retention rather than giving an inaccurate unconditional confirmation.

The proposed evaluation period is sixty days. The illustrative fee is EUR 900 and the suggested commencement date is 11 January 2027. Those details describe the proposed commercial arrangement; no date of birth or personal identifier is provided.

Section 4.2, article 15 and schedule 3 are references within the form. The words pursuer, defender, plaintiff, defendant and solicitor-advocate describe legal capacities or occupations only.

The signature and contact fields remain blank. No sample name, address, email, telephone value or account number is to be inserted in this circulation version.
